summary.business_type: Professional Services / B2B Agency (AI sales systems + custom software for SMBs, Mexico)
top_findings: og:image (social share preview) shows stale messaging from an old brand positioning — contradicts the current site entirely
No E-E-A-T signals: no About/founder page, no bio, no sameAs social links, no client proof
Single landing page is asked to rank for several distinct, high-intent keyword clusters at once — thin relative to that ambition
sitemap.xml only lists the homepage; aviso-legal.html (indexable) is missing
No security headers beyond HSTS (CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy all absent)
quick_wins: Remove the 3 mismatched aria-label attributes (nav logo, footer email, footer phone)
Fix the favicon <link> that declares type="image/png" for an .svg file
Trim the title tag (~71 chars) and meta description (~165 chars) to avoid SERP truncation
Add a Netlify _headers file with standard security headers

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS + HSTS enforced
Clean http->https and www->apex redirects
robots.txt present, permissive, references sitemap, no AI-crawler blocks
Valid canonical on homepage
Real 404 status on missing pages
Fast server response (130ms)

findings.title: sitemap.xml missing aviso-legal.html
findings.description: sitemap.xml lists only https://projectkrato.com/ with lastmod 2026-07-15. aviso-legal.html is indexable (robots: index,follow, has its own canonical) but absent from the sitemap.

findings.title: Missing standard security headers
findings.description: curl -I shows only strict-transport-security. No Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Add a Netlify _headers file (or netlify.toml [[headers]] block) with the standard set — no application code changes needed.

findings.title: Favicon <link> type/href mismatch
findings.description: <link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="/favicon.svg"> declares a PNG type but points at an SVG file.
findings.recommendation: Correct the type attribute or remove the redundant line (the first <link rel="icon"> already covers SVG).

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Clear, on-brand value proposition, direct hero framing
Consistent voice/tone matching documented brand guidelines
No duplicate content

findings.title: Single page covering multiple distinct keyword clusters
findings.description: ~500 words on the homepage try to serve CRM con IA, agentes de voz, software a medida, and automatización de ventas simultaneously.
findings.recommendation: Split into dedicated service pages once there's enough content per service, or deepen each homepage section first.

findings.title: No E-E-A-T signals
findings.description: No About/founder page, no bio for Antonio Cain, no sameAs links to a real professional profile, no case studies or testimonials.
findings.recommendation: Add a short founder/about section with credentials and a real LinkedIn link — highest-leverage trust fix available given the service is expensive and intangible.

findings.title: No client proof
findings.description: Expected pre-revenue, but worth flagging as the single biggest content lever once the first client lands.
findings.recommendation: Add a case study or quote as soon as one real client exists.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Single H1, clean heading hierarchy (4x h2, 7x h3, no skipped levels)
Complete Open Graph + Twitter Card tags with correct image dimensions
Canonical and viewport meta present

findings.title: Title tag too long (~71 chars)
findings.description: "Project Krato | Sistemas de Venta con IA + Software a Medida | México" risks SERP truncation.
findings.recommendation: Trim to ~58-60 chars, e.g. "Project Krato — Sistemas de Venta con IA para PYMEs México".

findings.title: Meta description too long (~165 chars)
findings.description: Over the ~155-160 char comfort zone before Google truncates it in the SERP.
findings.recommendation: Tighten to the strongest single sentence + CTA, under 155 characters.

findings.title: Minimal internal linking
findings.description: Only in-page anchors exist; aviso-legal.html is the only other real page.
findings.recommendation: Resolves naturally as more pages get added.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid ProfessionalService JSON-LD, confirmed via JSON parse
Good field coverage: contactPoint (x2, correctly typed), makesOffer (both service lines), areaServed, address

findings.title: No sameAs links
findings.description: No social/professional profile links in the schema.
findings.recommendation: Add once a real LinkedIn (or similar) profile exists.

findings.title: No founder/Person entity
findings.description: Antonio Cain isn't represented as a Person entity tied to the ProfessionalService.
findings.recommendation: Add once the About/bio content exists.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: Lighthouse (mobile, throttled): Performance 95, LCP 1.1s, CLS 0, FCP 0.9s, Speed Index 2.6s
Server response 130ms
No unminified CSS/JS or unused-code savings detected

findings.title: TBT slightly elevated
findings.description: Total Blocking Time is 260ms vs. the <200ms 'good' threshold, likely from the conditionally-loaded Spline 3D viewer (already desktop-gated at >960px).
findings.recommendation: Optional: defer the Spline script with requestIdleCallback for extra headroom.

findings.title: 3 links with mismatched aria-label
findings.description: nav-logo, footer email link, and footer phone link all have an aria-label that doesn't contain their visible text (WCAG 2.5.3), surfaced by the same Lighthouse run.
findings.recommendation: Remove the redundant aria-label on all three — visible text already serves as a good accessible name.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: robots.txt fully open to AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, CCBot)
Content structured in short, scannable, declarative blocks
Valid ProfessionalService schema gives LLMs an unambiguous entity description

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: Checked live — 404. Optional but on-brand given Project Krato's own AI positioning.
findings.recommendation: Add a short llms.txt summarizing the business and linking to service descriptions.

findings.title: No FAQ/Q&A structure
findings.description: Nothing is framed as directly citable question-and-answer content.
findings.recommendation: Add a short FAQ block with FAQPage schema once common prospect questions are known.

findings.title: Thin content limits citability
findings.description: Same root cause as the Content Quality thinness finding.

categories.name: Images
what_works: No tags at all — zero missing-alt-text issues by construction
All decorative visuals are inline SVG, correctly aria-hidden

findings.title: og-image.jpg shows stale, contradictory messaging
findings.description: Downloaded and viewed the live asset: it reads 'Inteligencia digital que convierte datos en decisiones' / 'Agencia de Inteligencia Digital · México' — an old positioning that contradicts the current site ('Tu negocio no tiene un problema de leads, tiene un problema de sistema'). Anyone sharing the homepage link sees this outdated preview card.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate og-image.jpg (1200x630) with current messaging and the corrected logo (black square, lime K).

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: None — no issues found that block indexing or risk a penalty

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Regenerate og-image.jpg with current messaging and corrected logo
Add a Netlify _headers file with standard security headers
Draft a short founder/about section with a real LinkedIn link

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Expand each service section with more depth, or split into dedicated service pages
Add a short FAQ block with FAQPage schema
Add the first case study/testimonial as soon as a client exists
Add sameAs + founder Person entity to the schema once profile links exist

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Register Google Search Console and GA4 (neither had credentials configured at audit time) to get real indexation and query data
Re-run this audit after the Phase 2/3 items ship to confirm score movement
